shape_hint: T-head (hammer-head) bolt: the head is a flat rectangular bar of length m, width n (= d) and height k, set crosswise on top of the shank; right under the head sits a short square neck, then a plain shank with a thread of length b at the end. In side view the head looks like a T.

role_map.m: head length (long side of the T)

notes: Nominal head sizes only (the standard also defines +/- tolerances, not published here). Rows M6-M24 only. DIN 186 form A/B (square neck) share these head dimensions in the sources. DIN 261 / DIN 188 (double nib) are separate standards, not published. P is the ISO coarse pitch (Wikipedia ISO 261 table, kova DIN 6914 for M24=3 and the fuller/fasteners.eu rows agree).
